shifts.summary: Overall the shift was rated Easy to Moderate by most analysts. Candidates attempted between 70 and 90 questions well, with a reported overall good‑attempt range of 70–90. Reasoning was mixed, some found it easy while others considered it moderate, and math was seen as the toughest section with many advanced topics and time pressure. GK was mostly static and English passages were lengthy but manageable.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Some matrix, syllogism and statement‑wise questions were time‑consuming; skipping a few helped finish. Sectional timer limited attempts, especially in non‑verbal items.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GK was mostly static with few current‑affair questions; factual content made it easy for those aware of basics.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Math section was lengthy with many advanced questions; time pressure caused difficulty, though some found it doable.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Passages were lengthy with some tough questions; synonym and one‑word substitution items were common.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 8 October 2026 was conducted in three shifts. Shifts 1 and 2 have been reported, while the analysis for shift 3 will be added after the shift ends. Unofficial figures suggest that candidates in shift 1 attempted between 70 and 90 questions well and rated the paper Easy to Moderate, whereas shift 2 saw a wider range of attempts from 22 to 89 and mixed difficulty across sections. SSC normalises scores across shifts, so direct comparison of raw attempts should be done cautiously.

faqs.q: What was the overall difficulty level for SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 on 8 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 1 was rated Easy to Moderate by most analysts, and shift 2 was also described as Easy to Moderate though some reports noted differences across sections. The analysis for shift 3 is pending.

faqs.q: How many questions were candidates able to attempt well in shift 1 of the 8 October 2026 exam?
faqs.a: Candidates in shift 1 reported a good‑attempt range of 70 to 90 questions overall.

faqs.q: What sections were considered the most challenging in shift 2 of the 8 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1?
faqs.a: Quantitative aptitude was noted as ranging from moderate to difficult, and reasoning featured statement‑wise items that added to the challenge.

faqs.q: When will the analysis for shift 3 of the 8 October 2026 exam be available?
faqs.a: The analysis for shift 3 will be added a few hours after the shift ends, once sufficient candidate reviews are collected.
